function isPlainClick(e): boolean

Defined in: core/utils/dom.ts:192

isPlainClick — true only for an unmodified primary activation: left button, no Ctrl/Meta/Shift/Alt. Nav anchors are real <a href> so a modified or middle click must reach the default action (open in new tab/window); handlers call this first and bail out before any preventDefault so the browser keeps native link semantics. Non-mouse clicks (keyboard Enter → detail 0, button −1/undefined on synthetic dispatches) count as plain — they carry no new-tab intent.

Parameters

e

Event

The click event.

Returns

boolean

True when the click is a plain primary activation.
